content.text:
All 4 tests pass, and repeated calls in one process now return only their own sections.

## What was wrong

Two coupled defects, both in `report.py`:

1. **`add_section(title, sections=[])`** — the default list is created once when the function is *defined*, not per call, so every call that omitted `sections` appended into the same shared list. That list outlived each `build_report` call and leaked into the next one.
2. **`build_report`** was silently depending on that leak to accumulate. It called `add_section(title)` and reassigned `result` each iteration, throwing away the previous return value — the only reason it ever built up a multi-section list was the shared default.

That's why the first call in a process looked correct and the second didn't: call one returned `['a','b']` from the shared list, call two returned `['a','b','a','b','c']`.

## The fix

```python
def add_section(title, sections=None):
    """Append a section and return the accumulated list."""
    if sections is None:
        sections = []
    sections.append(title)
    return sections


def build_report(titles):
    result = []
    for title in titles:
        result = add_section(title, result)
    return result
```

Fixing only the default would have left `build_report(["a","b"])` returning `["b"]` — so both halves were needed.

## What I ran

Wrote `test_report.py` (none existed) and ran it before the edit: `test_build_report_is_not_affected_by_a_previous_call` failed with `assert ['a','b','a','b','c'] == ['c']`, and `test_add_section_starts_fresh_each_call` failed the same way — the exact reported symptom. After the edit, all 4 pass, plus a manual four-calls-in-one-process check returning `['a','b']`, `['c']`, `['d','e']`, `[]`.

Two notes on scope: `add_section`'s caller-supplied-list form has no callers in this repo, so I preserved that signature and covered it with a test rather than removing it. And `build_report` itself is called by nothing in-repo, so I verified against the tests and a direct invocation — there's no downstream consumer here whose expectations I could check.
